description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ramos.
Ramos entering the battlefield triggers Remnant of the Rising Star, causing you to pay {5} to put five +1/+1 counters on Ramos.
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star
